mapper.sql: SELECT s.*,m.question_summary,m.answer_summary FROM ai.chat_session s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT question_summary,answer_summary FROM ai.chat_msg WHERE session_id=s.session_id ORDER BY created_at DESC,msg_id DESC LIMIT 1) m ON true
mapper.select: ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC,s.session_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM ai.chat_msg WHERE session_id=#{id} ORDER BY created_at,msg_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM ai.chat_msg WHERE session_id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM ai.chat_msg WHERE session_id=#{id} AND status_cd IN ('OK','PARTIAL') ORDER BY created_at DESC,msg_id DESC LIMIT 5

INSERT INTO ai.chat_msg(session_id,context_msg_id,question_summary,answer_summary,intent_cd,criteria,base_ym,source_refs,status_cd,created_at) VALUES(#{conversationId},#{contextId},#{question},#{answer},#{criteria.intent},CAST(#{criteriaJson} AS jsonb),#{criteria.baseYm},CAST(#{sourcesJson} AS jsonb),#{status},#{now}) RETURNING msg_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai.chat_session SET expires_at=#{expiresAt} WHERE session_key_hash=#{ownerHash} AND retention_until>#{now}
UPDATE ai.chat_session SET updated_at=#{now} WHERE session_id=#{conversationId} AND hidden_at IS NULL AND retention_until>#{now}
UPDATE ai.chat_msg SET context_msg_id=NULL WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM ai.chat_session WHERE retention_until<=#{now})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai.chat_msg WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM ai.chat_session WHERE retention_until<=#{now})
